text: Past medical history: No significant past medical or surgical history. No family history of breast cancer. Social history: Non-smoker, moderate alcohol use. Elementary school teacher.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Rapidly growing breast mass with constitutional symptoms is highly suggestive of an aggressive malignancy, such as inflammatory breast cancer or a high-grade invasive carcinoma; however, without the mammogram and ultrasound results to confirm structural abnormalities, a definitive diagnosis cannot be rendered.
